main.description: SSE stream of brief inference prompts derived from PDS commits. ADR-2605091700 path: pds-firehose-bridge → NATS JetStream subject `pds.repo.commit.app_bsky_feed_post` → ameno-langserver SSE generator → PDS pipethrough (Accept: text/event-stream preserved). Browser tabs subscribe with EventSource and run local Gemma/Baien inference, then post results via com.etzhayyim.apps.ameno.saveResult. Murakumo Tier 2 crowd-source (browser compute) entrypoint.

collection.description: AT collection NSID to subscribe (default: app.bsky.feed.post). Internal-only — restricted to social collections in handler.

maxEvents.description: Server closes the stream after N events to bound per-tab cost.

idleTimeoutSec.description: Server closes the stream after this many seconds with no new event.

schema.description: Each SSE `data:` line is a JSON object with these fields. `event:` line is one of: brief, error, done.

text.description: Extracted prompt text from the record (e.g. post.text)
